verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents applying one operation to many devices or items at once, such as bulk command dispatch, bulk configuration changes, or batch edits. What it does show is adjacent: fleet-wide viewing and analytics by device group or tag, configuration templates with no stated bulk-apply, and commands sent with a per-device button click. None of these is a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
